projects.title: Print Size Calculator
projects.label: Tool
projects.description: A precise calculator for photographers, designers, and print teams planning physical output from digital images.
projects.detail: It brings size, aspect ratio, resolution, and production-cost checks into one place, making it easier to compare options before sending work to print.

projects.title: Mimi's Tab Manager
projects.label: Chrome Extension
projects.description: A Chrome extension for turning crowded windows into searchable tab groups, saved sessions, and cleanup routines.
projects.detail: It is built for people who keep research, work, and admin contexts open at the same time and need a faster way back to the right tab set.

projects.title: Mixpanel Activity Navigator
projects.label: Chrome Extension
projects.description: A browser extension that speeds up Mixpanel investigations with event filtering and timeline navigation.
projects.detail: It supports the repetitive work of product analysis: scan user activity, keep key properties visible, and move through evidence without losing context.

projects.title: WhatsApp Reply Pal
projects.label: Chrome Extension
projects.description: A Chrome extension for drafting, reusing, and managing quick WhatsApp replies from the browser.
projects.detail: It is designed for repetitive messaging workflows where speed matters, but replies still need to stay consistent and easy to adjust.

projects.title: LingoLayer
projects.label: Chrome Extension
projects.description: A privacy-first Chrome extension that turns web pages into language-learning material locally in the browser.
projects.detail: It is designed for learners who want reading practice, vocabulary support, and page-level context without sending browsing content to a remote service.

projects.title: Haiku Mania
projects.label: Game
projects.description: A quick creative game for generating haiku prompts, short poems, and playful writing constraints.
projects.detail: It keeps the interaction lightweight so the focus stays on fast creative output, short-form constraints, and the next line.
